name: deep-inquiry
description: Upgrade shallow research into high-altitude, deep-substrate, cross-disciplinary inquiry using Strong Inference, real scientific/statistical instruments, raw data, and outside judges.

interface.shortDescription: Upgrade research across Altitude, Depth, and Range with Strong Inference and real instruments.
interface.longDescription: Corrects the default LLM tendency toward shallow literature summaries, confirmation bias, and vocabulary mimicry. Enforces the 4-question Depth upgrade, raw-substrate inspection, field-leading statistical/computational instruments, Platt's Strong Inference (competing hypotheses + falsification), cross-disciplinary methods without roleplay, and external non-self verification.
capabilities: Altitude, Depth, and Range question upgrading
Generative simulation, backtesting, and outside judges
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $deep-inquiry to investigate this problem from raw substrates using field-leading instruments, competing hypotheses, and an external verification judge.
